version_imported: Done, we published the document version.
unassigned: Done, we removed the document assignment.
download: Temporary link to view or download the document.
not_published: This document does not have a published version yet. Publish it before assigning it.
assignee_not_eligible: One of the people cannot receive the document: it can only be assigned to active or pending administrator, manager, delegate or collaborator accounts.
version_not_current: That version is no longer the current one. Open the document again to read the latest version.
already_accepted: You already accepted this version of the document.
acceptance_not_required: This document does not require acceptance.
external: External documents cannot be published from here yet.
